description: Post a message, as the user, in a conversation (forum) they take part in - an update on a mission, an answer in a decision thread, a note on a profit split. The other participants are notified. Use it ONLY when the user asked to say or record something; never to think out loud, and never to agree or refuse on their behalf (approving a decision, a split or a proposal is always their own click). The message is marked as written through an agent. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#postConversationMessageTool

message.description: The message, in the user's own words and language. Plain text.

name: postConversationMessageTool
